title: freedom-manifest/2
description: A Freedom dapp manifest, served as /freedom-manifest.json at the dapp's root (bzz, ipfs, ipns) or inline in a <script type="application/freedom-manifest+json"> element (web3 only). Normative text: SPEC.md §4. Three rules the schema cannot express are checked by the host: at most 64 capabilities in total across all provider blocks (SPEC.md §4.5), `icon` must be a relative path on served schemes and a `data:` URI on web3:// (SPEC.md §4.4), and `$schema` is allowed in the served file only (SPEC.md §4.2). Size caps: 8 KiB served, 32 KiB inline on web3://.

$schema.description: Editor hint: the URL of this schema. Ignored by the host; allowed in the served freedom-manifest.json only, not inline on web3:// (SPEC.md §4.2).

name.description: Display only; never the dapp's identity (SPEC.md §3.2).

icon.description: A relative path (`./icon.png`) on bzz/ipfs/ipns, or a `data:` URI of a PNG, JPEG or WebP on web3://. The image must be ≤ 16 KiB, 8–512 px on each side; the host re-encodes it (SPEC.md §4.4).

version.description: Shown by the update notice (SPEC.md §5.3). Any string up to 32 characters.

source.description: Where the dapp's code lives: a `rad://` RID or a URL. Shown on the details page.

author.description: Free text, unverified. The consent sheet still names the dapp key.

minSpecVersion.description: The lowest core specVersion the dapp needs; the host shows "needs a newer Freedom" when its own is lower.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, multibase (base58btc `z…`), for a signed manifest (SPEC.md §4.6).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, multibase (base58btc `z…`), over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this object with `signature` removed (SPEC.md §4.6).

rotation.description: The previous signing key's endorsement of `publicKey`: `from` is the previous key, `signature` its Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 bytes of the new `publicKey` string (SPEC.md §4.6).

relativePath.description: A same-origin relative path: no scheme (nothing of the form `name:`), no leading `/`, no `..` segment, no control characters.

capabilities.description: One sub-block per provider id (SPEC.md §4.3). Known providers are validated by their own schema; an unknown provider id (including the reserved `ipfs`, `chain` and `ethereum`, which a future revision may define) does not invalidate the manifest and is shown as ungrantable (SPEC.md §4.3, §12.4). Only `dapp`, the core's own prefix, is refused. The `swarm` block is byte-for-byte freedom-manifest/1's.

additionalProperties.description: A provider this schema does not know. Must be an object of rows; the host shows it as ungrantable.
